description: Pi sandbox policy as the launcher reads it: the Nix option pi.sandbox without ipc, with disabled grants removed. Nix owns this file; it is never read from a location the sandbox can write.

relativePath.description: Slash-separated path below its base: no leading slash, no empty, '.' or '..' segments.

grants.description: Tool state shared with the host, granted only when it exists. Keyed by grant name; applied in name order.

base.description: home: $HOME. config, cache, data: XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME from the launcher's own environment, or their $HOME defaults.

override.description: A variable in the launcher's own environment that replaces the whole location.

not.description: Writable single files are not supported.

writableHomePaths.description: Writable directories below $HOME that Pi uses besides its agent directory, granted at their canonical location.

runtimeEntries.description: Agent-directory entries that stay writable in locked-down sessions.

controlEntries.description: Agent-directory entries that are always protected, even when missing.

shellStartup.description: Shell startup paths kept read-only. config, cache and data entries apply below both the $HOME default and the XDG override.

secrets.description: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR entries that no grant may reach.

services.description: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR directories created before granting, for tools that cannot create them.

publicFiles.description: Files in ~/.ssh the sandbox may read despite the ~/.ssh deny rule. Only public files: never a private key.

agentIdentities.description: Private keys in ~/.ssh that the host launcher ensures are usable in its SSH agent. Never granted to the sandbox.

configurationRepositories.description: Directories below $HOME whose sessions may edit Pi setup. Each must also pass Git checkout validation.
